Senior Geotechnical Engineer  

Design what’s beneath. Shape what’s next. 

What if the work you did every day helped shape cities, communities and the future of infrastructure?

At Aurecon, that’s exactly what we do. We don’t just solve geotechnical challenges — we rethink them. From complex underground works to major infrastructure, we bring ideas to life in ways that are smarter, more sustainable and future-focused.

Now, we’re looking for a Senior Geotechnical Engineer to join our Ground & Underground team — someone who’s ready to lead, mentor and push technical boundaries.

What you’ll do 

You’ll play a key role in delivering technically complex, high-impact projects while helping grow the capability of those around you.

In this role, you will:

Lead geotechnical design across feasibility, concept and detailed phases
 Apply advanced analysis using tools like PLAXIS, GeoStudio, Rocscience and more
 Work across diverse environments — in-office, remote and embedded with clients
 Contribute to winning work through proposals and client engagement
 Mentor and guide junior engineers, building team capability
 Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to deliver innovative, practical outcomes
 Occasional attendance on site to support project delivery

What you’ll bring 

You’re technically strong, commercially aware and passionate about continuous learning.

We’re looking for:
 10+ years’ geotechnical engineering experience
 RPEQ certification is required
 Strong experience with FE modelling and geotechnical software
 Defence clearance (or ability to obtain)
 Willingness to attend site as required
 Proven ability to deliver high-quality designs and reports
 Confidence engaging with clients and stakeholders
 A collaborative mindset and a passion for mentoring
 Involvement in industry bodies such as AGS is (desirable)

Why Aurecon? 

Because here, your career is as important as the projects you work on.
 We’re proud to be recognised as a leader in innovation and sustainability — but what really sets us apart is how we invest in our people.

At Aurecon, you’ll get: 

Flexible work that fits your life (hybrid, part-time, job share options)
 Real career progression supported by mentoring and our Careers Hub
 Opportunities to work on iconic, meaningful projects across Australia and globally
 Inclusive, diverse teams where your voice is genuinely valued
 Competitive parental leave, wellbeing programs and cultural holiday swaps

jobs.title: Lead Civil Engineer - Land Infrastructure
jobs.description:
Lead Civil Engineer - Land Infrastructure 

At Aurecon, we are optimistic about the future. We are thinkers, solvers, and collaborators who work with our clients to deliver the infrastructure and assets that strengthen communities and create a sustainable future.

What you’ll do 

As a Lead Civil Engineer – Land Infrastructure  in our Perth Land Infrastructure team, you’ll play a key role in delivering complex land development, urban infrastructure and road projects across Perth and regional Western Australia.

You’ll work closely with our clients and multidisciplinary teams, providing technical leadership and taking projects from early planning and concept design through to detailed design and construction.

Lead the delivery of land development, urban infrastructure and road projects
 Deliver civil design across roads, earthworks, drainage, utilities and subdivision infrastructure
 Lead projects from concept and structure planning through detailed design, tender and construction
 Provide technical leadership and coordinate multidisciplinary project teams
 Manage project budgets, programs, risks and key stakeholder relationships
 Support projects across residential, industrial, commercial and resources sectors
 Ensure designs meet relevant Main Roads WA, Austroads, Australian Standards and local government requirements

What you’ll bring 

Around 10 years of experience in civil engineering, ideally across land development and urban infrastructure in Western Australia
 A Bachelor of Engineering (Civil), with CPEng or progress towards Chartership highly regarded
 Strong experience across road geometry, earthworks, drainage, utilities and subdivision design
 Experience delivering residential subdivisions, road upgrades, industrial/commercial developments or urban renewal projects
 Understanding of AutoCAD, Civil 3D and/or 12d
 Knowledge of drainage design and modelling tools such as DRAINS or XPSWMM would be advantageous
 Strong knowledge of WA approval processes and relevant Main Roads WA, local government, Austroads and Australian Standards requirements
 Strong project management, client engagement and stakeholder management capability
 Resources sector experience, including exposure to clients such as Rio Tinto or BHP, would be advantageous
